description.en: Teaches a character a Special Move with the jingle J_08 and the message "sysmes-Skill-00001" (RunUnlockSkillUseMsg). The move itself is given with CMND_SKILL_UNLOCK.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".

examples.case: Learning a new move (real usage, from ev42033100.nut)
